overview_description.description: Peko is an all-in-one platform that allows businesses to handle all of their payments, bills, travel, and insurance while also automating many tasks. Peko is an all-in-one business management platform that helps companies manage payments, expenses, payroll, invoicing, travel, insurance, and operations from a single digital dashboard. It streamlines financial workflows, automates routine business tasks, improves cash flow visibility, and integrates with multiple systems to enhance efficiency, productivity, and overall enterprise operational control.
